Name: La Sangre
Components: V, S, M (a crumpled drawing of something you love)
Description: You coalesce blood in your palm to form a hardblood lance, hungry for blood. You then move up to your movement speed in any direction, performing a melee spell attack against a creature within range, dealing 2d8 piercing damage and inflicting 2 Bleed on a hit. You have a +1 bonus for the Lance’s attack and damage rolls and inflict an additional Bleed Count for each 10-ft travelled, to a maximum of +4.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 by each level above 2nd.
